messages.回避「戦闘呼吸」と「精密照準」で呼吸を一気に積み、S2「ヘッドショット」・S3「: A Pierce attacker that rapidly builds Poise through the evade Combat Poise and Precision Aim, then deals heavy critical damage with S2 Headshot and S3 Goin' for the Bullseye. S1 spends most of his ammunition, so managing it determines how long he stays on the field.
messages.呼吸の積み方: 守備「戦闘呼吸」は、回避に成功したときだけ呼吸3を得る(1ターン: **Building Poise**: The Defense skill Combat Poise grants 3 Poise only on a successful Evade, up to 3 times per turn. The combat passive Precision Aim (2 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) grants 10 Poise and 1 Pierce Power Up next turn if he did not use a single attack skill that turn (including E.G.O skills, excluding attacks from Target Spotted). With multiple slots, all slots must be non-attacks. He also gains 1 Haste next turn per 10 Poise at Turn End, up to 2.
messages.S3「一点狙い」: 使用時に集中[狙撃](最大4、ターン終了時に1増える)を全部: **S3 — Goin' for the Bullseye**: On use, spends all Concentration【Sniper】 (up to 4, increasing by 1 at Turn End), gaining Poise Potency equal to amount spent×2 and damage equal to ×12.5%. +10% damage per point of Speed difference with the target, up to 50%. On Critical Hit, in addition to extra Critical damage, it spends Poise Potency above 30 (up to 10) to increase damage.
messages.「ロジックアトリエ製 高速粉砕弾」: 戦闘に出場したとき、弾丸-ロジックアトリエ: **AL-HV Pulverisation Round**: When he enters battle, he gains 1 Ammo - Atelier Logic (once per battle). With it, S3 becomes this enhanced version.
messages.弾丸と後方支援配置: S1「応射」はⅠ〜Ⅲコインで1回に3、S2・S3は1消耗す: **Ammo and Overwatch Assignment**: S1 Return Fire spends 3 per use with Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ, and S2 and S3 spend 1. If all Ammo is 0 at Turn End, he steps back into Overwatch Assignment (once per battle). On rejoining, Concentration【Sniper】 is maxed, he gains 3 Pierce Power Up, and his regular ammo is reloaded (except the Atelier Logic round). He has 10 regular rounds.
messages.初動の強さ: パッシブ「狙撃」で、ステージ開始時に貫通威力増加3を得る。S2はマ: **Strong opening**: Through the passive Snipe, he gains 3 Pierce Power Up at stage start. S2 has a high Clash Power of 8–20 (10–22 at higher Uptie) and grants 3 Poise, +1/2 Poise Count, and 2 Haste next turn on use.
messages.終止符事務所代表ホンルとの連携: ホンルが出場していると、守備を使ったときに攻撃: **Coordination with Hong Lu's Full-Stop Office Rep**: While Hong Lu is deployed, using his Defense skill requests Melee Support against the attacker, once per turn.
messages.1ターン目は貫通威力増加3を活かしてS1・S2でマッチを取りに行き、呼吸回数を稼: On turn 1, use the 3 Pierce Power Up to take Clashes with S1 and S2 and build Poise Count. After that, create turns with no attacks by setting every slot to non-attacks such as Combat Poise. Build Poise Potency all at once through successful Evades and Precision Aim, then aim for big damage with S3's Critical Hit. If you do not want him to step back, the safe choice from turn 2 on is to turn S1 into his Defense skill or E.G.O to conserve Ammo. In consecutive battles, have a backup unit ready to fill the gap when he steps back. Deploying him with Hong Lu's Full-Stop Office Rep lets him keep attacking even while defending as he builds Poise, a good pairing.
